editor.budget_rule: an arm's tokens are the sum of editor_tokens and its seconds the sum of host seconds from launch to end over its sessions (the survey counts to LT); before each session the arm is checked; at or over either cap no new session of that arm starts and every planned item of it is recorded as skipped (unedited)
editor.model: gpt-6.1-sol, reasoning effort medium, Codex CLI 0.161.0 in the qualified container

hr03.stop_rule: 3 or more of an arm's 20 pages with a factual loss or error stops the run before answers

primary_test.dependence_disclosure: areas are chained on one tree and share trunk pages, so they are not independent; the result is 'pre-registered within an exploratory run'
primary_test.minimum_attainable_p: 2 / 2^n for n areas with a computable difference
primary_test.null: LN, the frozen Sprint 13 locality rule; buckets it cannot compute are reported as not computable and the area is dropped from the test, never imputed
primary_test.reference: exact sign-flip permutation over areas of the mean difference (wc_refinement_15.sign_flip_test)
primary_test.statistic: per area: z of magnetic_lambda1_q0.25 against the LN null on the area subgraph view (pooled null SD as in wc_refinement_15), LT pass value minus R0 pass value

provenance_credit.credit: P is derived from B if the host alignment holds (declared or not); a declared source without host alignment is reported as unconfirmed and earns no credit
provenance_credit.distinctive_unit: at least 30 characters and present in at most 3 baseline pages
provenance_credit.equivalence: support unit B on variant v = {B if B survives in v} + {B's survivor under moved_content_majority_v1 if B was removed} + {every added or changed page derived from B}
provenance_credit.host_alignment: baseline page B shares at least 1 distinctive new unit with variant page P
provenance_credit.new_units: units of the variant page that its own baseline version (if any) does not hold
provenance_credit.scope: computed once on each arm's final tree against O; declarations are pooled over the arm's sessions
provenance_credit.status: confirmed by the author October 14 (docs/wc-freeze-16.md); a sensitivity analysis, direct judgment primary (D11b)
provenance_credit.unit: rr.content_units (normalized non-blank line, link targets stripped, lines without alphanumerics dropped)

ragas.comparison: plain mean, paired bootstrap 95% CI; repeat shift 0.005-0.015 disclosed as the noise floor

pricing.source: Anthropic first-party API price list as recorded by the claude-api skill (cached 2026-10-06), rechecked 2026-10-12

ragas.set: tier 2: FactualCorrectness main; Faithfulness and ContextRecall descriptive with repeat variance; no per-answer claims

status: frozen before any Sprint 16 model call; the survey and tier-1 generation follow authorization 1

tables.intervals: bootstrap 95% clustered by question; duplicate-text pairs clustered together
tables.rule: one per tier, never pooled: LT - O, R0 - O, LT - R0, with S - O beside every row

tier1.answers: 4 conditions (1 or 6 searches x follow on/off) x 2 replicates on O, S, LT, R0 = 480
tier1.quote_survival: reported per refined corpus, not gating
tier1.ragas: none on tier 1 (FactualCorrectness omitted, author October 14)
tier1.review: the author reviews every core element before Sprint 17 (HR-19); until then they are proposals
tier1.secondary_score: boolean rubric judge (qwen3:14b, thinking off, relaxed quote match)
tier1.tasks: 15: the 5 existing 11b tasks, the 2 unselected Docker panel candidates, and 8 new tasks generated after the survey from areas the existing 7 do not cover (D6a/D6b)

tier2.answers: 1 search, follow on and follow off, 1 replicate, on O, S, LT, R0
tier2.label: LLM-verified support (Claude Haiku 5.5); author spot-check precision 0.85 (Wilson 95% 0.70-0.94, 29/34), miss rate 0.00 (0.00-0.10, 0/33)

metrics.navigation: support read or cited; searches to first support; follows landing on support; share of follows over editor-added edges
metrics.retrievers: RA lexical, embedding, graph-expand (Sprint 15 pins), Recall@5, nDCG@10, MRR, score_ranked pooled

tier2.old_labels: the automatic top-5 labels are a historical comparison only
tier2.pool_completion: Sprint 19 judges every unjudged (query, page, page content) in the top 10 of every evaluated run on S/LT/R0 and every page a tier-2 trace read or cited, with the same frozen prompt and settings (support verify --prior); then scores

usd_stop.scope: all remaining API spend of the project (D11d)
